# The ledger's options

Pass `--limit` to print only the newest amounts.

Pass `--plain` for the bare number.

Pass `--confirm` to skip the question.

`ledger close` asks before it closes the day unless `--confirm` is given.

`ledger reset --confirm` empties the ledger without asking.
